sourceIdentityNote: Full GitHub Blob API payload fetched; UTF-8 byte length and Git blob SHA-1 recomputed and matched the pinned object.

scannerContract.eventTargetLifetime: Original onChange reads event.target.files before its first await; wfPackScanFolder immediately snapshots Array.from(fileList) before awaiting File.text(). The adapter retains the FileList on the input until the next successful folder selection.

historicalWmlBaseline.reason: Historical WML contract is not the FAITH 3.0.0 acceptance baseline.

nativeUploadAdapter.requestDetection: capture-phase click interception for input[type=file][webkitdirectory] and its associated label; never inferred from showDirectoryPicker or FileChooserParams mode
nativeUploadAdapter.nativeSelection: ACTION_OPEN_DOCUMENT_TREE through the shared capability-guarded ImagePackDirectoryAccess SAF backend
nativeUploadAdapter.traversal: recursive SAF document enumeration with normalized relative path segments
nativeUploadAdapter.fileCollection: FileList prototype-compatible array-like object with length, item(index), numeric entries, and Symbol.iterator
nativeUploadAdapter.fileObject: lazy SAF-backed Blob subclass with File prototype compatibility and webkitRelativePath
nativeUploadAdapter.eventTarget: FileList remains attached to the original input after synchronous event dispatch; the next successful selection replaces it. The original scanner's Array.from() snapshot preserves prior File objects during an overlapping async scan.
nativeUploadAdapter.cancellation: AbortError dispatches the input cancel event; other failures dispatch waywardfoldererror and a diagnostic

safetyLimits.memory: Native SAF reads buffer the complete file, Base64-encode it, then JavaScript decodes it. File.stream() chunks consumption only after decoding; this is not end-to-end streaming. The 32 MiB per-file cap bounds memory amplification.

nativeUploadAdapter.sameOriginFrames: document-start script is installed for every frame matching the active game origin; runtime fallback remains origin-checked
nativeUploadAdapter.writableStream: Bounded FileSystemWritableFileStream-like sink exposing write(), seek(), truncate(), close(), abort(); supports string, Blob, ArrayBuffer, TypedArray/DataView and standard write/seek/truncate command objects. 32 MiB in-memory staging; not a native WritableStream subclass.
nativeUploadAdapter.permissionSemantics: queryPermission() inspects persisted SAF grants only. requestPermission({mode:'readwrite'}) starts a user-mediated SAF selection and grants write access only if the same tree is reselected with a persisted write grant; cancellation resolves denied.
